def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    lines = []

            lines.append([(r,c) for c in range(w)])
    for c in range(w):

            lines.append([(r,c) for r in range(h)])
    for cells in lines:
        val = grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c] = (val + 1) % 10
    return out
PY
